title: understand concepts v1
description: The results of the pass concepts (corpus arxiv AX7.3): the MSC2020 codes and the concepts of each item, and the terms of a definition.

id.description: the id of the item, as ax://paper/2401.00001#K3F9

msc.description: MSC2020 codes at five characters, such as 14J60, the first one first

wikidata.description: the Wikidata item, such as Q193297, only when you know it exactly

name.description: the common name of the concept

symbol.description: the macro or the symbol, as \mathcal{M}_g

terms.description: for a definition only: the terms that it defines
